name: Merve Gürsoy
bio:
Merve Gürsoy discovered her love of writing at a young age. She wrote her first poem about the concept of death when she was twelve; years later, drawing from the same theme, she wrote her first children’s book, My Grandfather’s Mandarin Tree.

She graduated from the Department of Turkish Language and Literature and completed a master’s degree in pedagogy. In her professional life, where she uses writing as a tool for communication, she has worked as a copywriter for fifteen years and continues to write stories for children. She sees the simplicity and creativity in children’s way of looking at the world as the most delicate area of writing. She cares deeply about crafting her stories in a language that settles into children’s hearts and stays in adults’ minds.

She loves empathy, compassion, kindness, joy, animals, potted plants, and pencils. She lives in Istanbul with her husband, her son, and their two cats.
